name: ye_qing
prompt: Create a production-ready 2D skeletal character PARTS ATLAS from the referenced chibi character, retaining exact face, hair, costume, clean sharp anime rendering and colors. Far means viewer-left, near viewer-right. Head UNMASKED visible real human face. No gritty textures, halftone, paper or stains. This is a mechanical animation asset sheet, NOT character poses.
